ApiConfiguration.description: Describes the API configuration for a code generation job.

CodegenDependency.description: Dependency package that may be required for the project code to run.

IsSemVer.description: Determines if the dependency package is using Semantic versioning.

Reason.description: Indicates the reason to include the dependency package in your project code.

SupportedVersion.description: Indicates the version of the supported dependency package.

CodegenFeatureFlags.description: Describes the feature flags for a code generation job.

IsNonModelSupported.description: Specifies whether a code generation job supports non models.

IsRelationshipSupported.description: Specifies whether a code generation job supports data relationships.

CodegenGenericDataEnum.description: Describes the enums in a generic data schema.

Values.description: The list of enum values in the generic data schema.

CodegenGenericDataField.description: Describes a field in a generic data schema.

DataType.description: The data type for the generic data field.

DataTypeValue.description: The value of the data type for the generic data field.

IsArray.description: Specifies whether the generic data field is an array.

ReadOnly.description: Specifies whether the generic data field is read-only.

Required.description: Specifies whether the generic data field is required.

CodegenGenericDataModel.description: Describes a model in a generic data schema.

Fields.description: The fields in the generic data model.

IsJoinTable.description: Specifies whether the generic data model is a join table.

PrimaryKeys.description: The primary keys of the generic data model.

CodegenGenericDataNonModel.description: Describes a non-model in a generic data schema.

Fields.description: The fields in a generic data schema non model.

CodegenGenericDataRelationshipType.description: Describes the relationship between generic data models.

AssociatedFields.description: The associated fields of the data relationship.

BelongsToFieldOnRelatedModel.description: The value of the belongsTo field on the related data model.

CanUnlinkAssociatedModel.description: Specifies whether the relationship can unlink the associated model.

IsHasManyIndex.description: Specifies whether the @index directive is supported for a hasMany data relationship.

RelatedJoinFieldName.description: The name of the related join field in the data relationship.

RelatedJoinTableName.description: The name of the related join table in the data relationship.

RelatedModelFields.description: The related model fields in the data relationship.

RelatedModelName.description: The name of the related model in the data relationship.

CodegenJobAsset.description: Describes an asset for a code generation job.

DownloadUrl.description: The URL to use to access the asset.

CodegenJobGenericDataSchema.description: Describes the data schema for a code generation job.

DataSourceType.description: The type of the data source for the schema.

CodegenJobRenderConfig.description: Describes the configuration information for rendering the UI component associated with the code generation job. This is a union type with a single member.

DataStoreRenderConfig.description: Describes the DataStore configuration for an API for a code generation job.

GraphQLRenderConfig.description: Describes the GraphQL configuration for an API for a code generation job.

FragmentsFilePath.description: The path to the GraphQL fragments file, relative to the component output directory.

MutationsFilePath.description: The path to the GraphQL mutations file, relative to the component output directory.

QueriesFilePath.description: The path to the GraphQL queries file, relative to the component output directory.

SubscriptionsFilePath.description: The path to the GraphQL subscriptions file, relative to the component output directory.

TypesFilePath.description: The path to the GraphQL types file, relative to the component output directory.

NoApiRenderConfig.description: Describes the configuration for an application with no API being used.

ReactStartCodegenJobData.description: Describes the code generation job configuration for a React project.

InlineSourceMap.description: Specifies whether the code generation job should render inline source maps.

RenderTypeDeclarations.description: Specifies whether the code generation job should render type declaration files.

Script.description: The file type to use for a JavaScript project.

Tag.description: A key-value pair that is used to tag the code generation job.

schema.description: Represents an Amplify UI Builder code generation job resource. This is a read-only resource that provides visibility into code generation jobs started via the Amplify UI Builder API.

AppId.description: The unique ID for the Amplify app.

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the code generation job.

AutoGenerateForms.description: Specifies whether to autogenerate forms in the code generation job.

EnvironmentName.description: The name of the backend environment that is a part of the Amplify app.

Id.description: The unique ID for the code generation job.

Status.description: The status of the code generation job.

Tags.description: One or more key-value pairs that are assigned to the code generation job.
